title: Block Drift City
description: A solo Minecraft mashup where you build your own block city, gather resources, craft upgrades, and drift through streets, desert strips, and mountain passes. Start with a garage, unlock your first ride, and expand into a survival sandbox built around speed, progression and open-world exploration.

launch.notes: The mashup runs inside the Minecraft host. Drift Legends 2 contributes the vehicle feel and companion gameplay without shipping copied files with the upload.
